title: A Member could use another user's private gateway.
proof: The Member could not list or open the private gateway. The Member supplied its ID during an agent launch. Runloop then used the gateway owner's test credential.
fix: Check the owner and organization each time Runloop uses a gateway ID.

title: A sandboxed agent could make a server-side request.
proof: A test callback showed that the request came from a Runloop gateway service, not the Devbox. A local network target returned a live HTTP response.
fix: Block private network addresses before each request and after each redirect.

title: OAuth setup followed a redirect to a local address.
proof: Before an MCP setup or agent existed, the Reflex server fetched a selected OAuth file. A test redirect sent its registration request to a local address.
fix: Allow only public HTTPS addresses during OAuth setup. Check the address again after each redirect.

title: The MCP test returned part of a server response.
proof: A test server returned a unique marker in an HTTP 500 response. The same marker appeared in the MCP connection error shown to the user.
fix: Allow only public HTTPS addresses. Check each redirect. Do not show server response bodies to the user.

title: The file tool blocked a file. The command tool read it.
proof: The file tool blocked a test file outside the selected folder. The command tool read the same file from the connected Mac.
fix: Apply the selected folder limit to commands and subprocesses, not only the file tool.
